tellings.difference: Told by journalist Pavel, who says the lawsuit forced the Ministry of Culture and the government to take the case more seriously; no dollar figure is given.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Jaime Maussan's lawsuit against the Peruvian government in 2024-2025. This telling adds what the suit is said to have achieved.

as_told.title: Lawsuit forces the Peruvian government to take the case seriously

plain: Jaime Maussan, who champions a set of small three-fingered bodies found in Peru that some call alien, says he filed a lawsuit against the Peruvian government for $300 million. A journalist named Pavel, on the same episode, says that once Maussan "started doing the whole lawsuit stuff", Peru's Ministry of Culture and government were forced to take the case more seriously. Both tell it to Michels as a way the bodies were pushed onto the official agenda.
